findings.title: review_required(trigger) trusts proposer-controlled classification
findings.evidence_summary: The old candidate accepted an opaque trigger string and checked only membership in MANDATORY_REVIEW_TRIGGERS; a material governance change mislabeled ROUTINE_FORMATTING could receive NONE.
findings.required_change: Derive mandatory-review classification from platform-owned/trusted action context or otherwise fail closed for governance-relevant/material authority changes.

findings.title: Transport outcome to promotion evidence wiring is not proven end-to-end
findings.evidence_summary: The old candidate tested DispatchResult failure and a separate promotion boolean but did not provide one trusted path that converts received review evidence into promotion eligibility.
findings.required_change: Promotion must validate ReviewRequest/ReviewEvidence and trusted execution provenance directly rather than accept a caller-provided review-valid flag.

findings.title: Evidence validation relied on earlier required-provider construction invariant
findings.evidence_summary: validate_review_evidence skipped provider enforcement when required_reviewer.provider was absent.
findings.required_change: Re-enforce required reviewer identity invariants at evidence acceptance.

findings.title: Portable bundle completeness was not proven
findings.evidence_summary: The old markdown packet omitted runtime files its own governance contract described as load-bearing and structural bundle validation did not prove completeness.
findings.required_change: Bind required review artifact set/evidence refs and fail closed on incomplete bundles.

findings.title: Markdown-fenced artifact hashes were not independently reproducible
findings.evidence_summary: Extracted code differed by one byte from declared hashes, consistent with newline/fence representation ambiguity.
findings.required_change: Provide raw canonical artifacts or explicit canonicalization rules so independent reviewers can reproduce hashes.

evidence_assessment: All embedded tests in the old packet reportedly passed, but the review identified trigger-classification, integration, reviewer-invariant, bundle-completeness, and hash-reproducibility gaps.
reason_not_current_promotion_evidence: The review targets superseded request REV-GOV-PR5-003 and manual-relay reviewer identity is not provider-authenticated.
